title: ID0453584-DC/Si-D/DK-[MP / R3 170001659] Missing converter DC4
description:
Possible solution:
I’m sending you a screenshot of the converter number that the charger was able to detect. This means that the number you see in the charger but not in the screenshot I sent is the one that is missing communication with the charger.
After that, you detect the converter that is with the issue.
There are three possible solutions:
First, check the  Cancommloss  that is connected to that converter. If it is attached correctly, move to the next step.
Try swapping the converter that shows the issue with the one beside it, just to confirm whether the problem is the Cancommloss or the converter.
If the issue remains after swapping, it confirms that the converter itself is faulty. In that case, replace the converter.
